corrected_phase1_conclusion: Goal hard-gate bottleneck = REJECTED. Goal Student strong-negative = CONFIRMED. Goal legitimate negative suite = PARTIALLY (t00/t07 only). Teacher critical availability = CONFIRMED on 8/10 goal tasks. Label contract defect = CONFIRMED (cc is first funnel filter).

evidence_summary.source: K10 OPPORTUNITY LABELER V1 audit (800 episodes, 40 tasks)
evidence_summary.key_finding: candidate_close is the FIRST filter in the K10 labeler funnel. Steps with cc=False are eliminated before any physical assessment (grasp, lift, critical).
evidence_summary.interpretation: Goal t01 has 44 critical steps detected by Teacher physics. But all 20 episodes have no_corridor (no 10-step continuous window). The cc gate reduces entry from 855 candidate steps to 44 critical steps, but the corridor length kills it.

H1_teacher_no_critical.verdict: TRUE for t00 and t07 only (2/10 goal tasks)
H1_teacher_no_critical.evidence: t00 and t07 have funnel={critical: 0} — zero cc steps AND zero critical. These tasks genuinely have no close action and no physical engagement windows.
H1_teacher_no_critical.implication: For t00/t07, V4 no-emit is CORRECT behavior. For other 8 tasks, Teacher DOES detect critical.

H2_label_killed_by_cc.verdict: CONFIRMED — cc is first filter in K10 labeler funnel
H2_label_killed_by_cc.evidence: ALL tasks show candidate_close as first funnel stage. cc=False steps never reach physical assessment. P(label|cc=False)=0 by construction, not correlation.
H2_label_killed_by_cc.implication: Training label contract is defective. N5 MUST decouple critical from candidate_close. The labeler should assess physical state FIRST, then separately track close_intent as a soft feature.

H3_student_generalization_failure.verdict: LIKELY — Student learned goal→negative from label distribution
H3_student_generalization_failure.evidence: Even for goal tasks with feasible windows (t06, t08, t09), the fraction of positive steps is tiny (<10%). Student raw_logit ≈ -11 on goal steps (strong negative). The cc gate in labels means Student never saw positive examples on cc=False steps, making all goal steps appear negative during training.
H3_student_generalization_failure.implication: N5 retraining with decoupled labels required. Goal tasks need positive label coverage on their critical windows (which exist but are currently masked by cc gate).

H4_teacher_rules_miss_goal_physics.verdict: PARTIALLY TRUE — cc gate is an action filter, not a physical filter
H4_teacher_rules_miss_goal_physics.evidence: The physical filters (stable_grasp, lift, critical) DO detect engagement on goal tasks (44-510 critical steps per task). But they're only reached after cc filter. The fundamental issue is using action intent (cc) as a prerequisite for physical assessment, rather than as an independent signal.
H4_teacher_rules_miss_goal_physics.implication: N5 should use physical-state-based critical definition. cc should be demoted from prerequisite gate to independent feature head.

root_cause_chain.description: Why V4 detector outputs ~0 on all goal steps
chain: 1. K10 labeler uses candidate_close as FIRST funnel filter
2. All cc=False steps get label=0 regardless of physical state
3. Goal tasks have 70% cc=False steps → 70% of training data is negative by construction
4. On cc=True goal steps, K10 corridor length < 10 → label=0 for most tasks
5. Only 3/10 goal tasks have any positive labels, and even those are sparse (<5% of steps)
6. Student learns: goal suite features → low score (raw_logit ≈ -11)
7. At inference: goal steps → Student outputs strong negative → cal_prob ≈ 0.005
8. Score << τ=0.855 → no emit regardless of scheduler variant
9. Full 51D features don't help because Student was trained to suppress goal features

label_contract.action: Decouple critical from candidate_close. Build critical label from physical state only (grasp, manipulation, contact, lift, target_progress, release_safe). cc becomes independent close_intent feature.
label_contract.expected_effect: Goal tasks with physical engagement (8/10) will have positive critical labels even when cc=False.

k10_feasibility.action: Separate K10 corridor assessment from cc. K10_feasible should check: (a) horizon ≥ 10 steps remaining, (b) not in release_safe phase, (c) not post-success. It should NOT require cc.
k10_feasibility.expected_effect: More K10 feasible windows on goal tasks, especially t01-t05 which have critical but fail corridor.

training_data.action: Goal tasks need oversampling or suite-balanced batches. Currently dominated by libero_10 (92.6% of positive steps per R10 diagnostic).
training_data.expected_effect: Student will learn goal-specific critical features instead of suppressing them.

multi_head_architecture.action: critical_head (physical state), k10_feasible_head (horizon/safety), release_safe_head, close_intent_head (soft evidence).
multi_head_architecture.expected_effect: Each head can specialize; close_intent no longer gates criticality.
